about_the_game:
English only:
Please note: This demo does not reflect the game's final version.

Step into the haunting world of Lirai: Heir of Darkness, a story-driven action game set in a dark world. Take your first steps into Lirai's journey — where courage and fate intertwine.
In this demo, experience an early slice of the game with temporary visuals, altered story elements, and characters that do not fully represent the final product. Some key features, graphics, and mechanics have been adjusted for demo purposes to avoid spoilers and preserve the full experience for the official release.

⚔️ Key Notes:

  • The graphics, animations, and overall presentation are not final and will be significantly improved in the full version.

  • Story elements have been modified to prevent major spoilers.

  • Some characters and assets used here are placeholders or early designs.

  • This demo is no longer actively supported or updated since mid-2024.

We hope you enjoy this early glimpse into the dark legacy of Lirai. Your feedback during this stage has been invaluable in shaping the final experience.

content_descriptors.notes: Lirai: Heir of Darkness contains intense violence and graphic depictions of combat, including blood, dismemberment, and gore. The game features dark and disturbing themes, unsettling storylines, and occasional imagery that may be uncomfortable to some players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: Lirai: Heir of Darkness is a third-person action game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies and demons. Fear and destruction reign. This demo does not reflect the final game. Content has been altered and is no longer supported.
